idea.research_question: Can Landsat and Sentinel-2 observations be fused to improve early-stage crop or land-cover classification across heterogeneous landscapes?
idea.hypothesis: Landsat provides longer temporal context while Sentinel-2 contributes finer spectral detail, so feature-level fusion should improve early-stage class separability and transferability.
idea.mechanism: Cloud masking, cross-sensor harmonization and temporal compositing create aligned optical features; a classifier compares fused features with single-sensor baselines.
idea.analytical_approach: Cross-sensor feature fusion, supervised classification and spatial cross-validation
idea.expected_contribution: A reproducible benchmark for testing whether a proposed idea preserves all required data roles and adds auxiliary data only for a distinct mechanism, validation or refinement purpose.
idea.falsification_condition: The idea fails if it drops a required role, cannot align the required inputs, or does not improve explanatory, predictive or validation performance over the appropriate single-source baseline.
